options.name: accept_licenses
options.description: If this is set to V(true), the module attempts to accept license prompts generated by C(sdkmanager) during package installation. Otherwise, every license prompt is rejected.

options.name: channel
options.description: Indicates what channel must C(sdkmanager) use for installation of packages.

options.name: name
options.description: A name of an Android SDK package (for instance, V(build-tools;34.0.0)).

options.name: sdk_root
options.description: Provides path for an alternative directory to install Android SDK packages to. By default, all packages are installed to the directory where C(sdkmanager) is installed.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the desired package(s) state. V(present) ensures that package(s) is/are present. V(absent) ensures that package(s) is/are absent. V(latest) ensures that package(s) is/are installed and updated to the latest version(s).
